Are you the new forklift hero of Bavaria?
At Bavaria, we are looking for enthusiastic forklift drivers to join our logistics team. In this full-time role, you play a key part in ensuring that our logistics processes run smoothly every day. Do you want to work for one of the world’s most iconic beer brands in a dynamic and team-oriented environment? Then keep reading!

What will you do?
As a forklift driver, you play an essential role in our warehouse operations. You ensure that pallets filled with our beverages are placed in the right location in a safe and structured way. Once production is completed, you take over and carefully move goods throughout the warehouse.
You will also support export activities, making sure our products are prepared correctly and reach international customers safely and on time.

Your daily tasks

- Using an on-board computer, you know exactly which pallets need to be moved and where they should go.
- You prepare goods for shipment to customers around the world.
- You work closely with your colleagues and always maintain a safe working environment.
- You get the chance to learn different areas of the warehouse, with the order pool as your fixed base.

Working hours & flexibility
At Bavaria, we work with both day shifts and a 3-shift system. Flexibility is important:

Day shifts

- 08:00 – 16:30
- 09:30 – 18:00

3-shift system

- Early shift: 06:00 – 14:00
- Late shift: 14:00 – 22:00
- Night shift: 22:00 – 06:00 (always in blocks of 4 nights)

This way, we offer a varied but structured work schedule where your contribution truly makes a difference.

*This is a temporary position lasting approximately till April 2027.

- You are in possession of a valid forklift certificate;
- You are fluent in either Dutch or English;
- You are willing to work in shift patterns, including day shifts.

Are you looking for a flexible job that fits perfectly into your life? Become an Uber Eats delivery courier!

Decide when you work, cycle through the city, and earn money while doing it. With Uber Eats, you enjoy the freedom to work on your own terms. 

What are you going to do?
As a courier for Uber Eats, you’ll be the link between restaurants and hungry customers.

Your main tasks are:

- Picking up meals from local restaurants
- Navigating the fastest route using the Uber Eats app
- Delivering with a smile and punctuality – keeping customers happy and well-fed

What do we offer?
- Salary: Starting at €16,19 gross/hour (age 21+), including holiday pay
- Peak earnings: Up to € 18,69 gross/hour with daily bonuses and and keep 100% of your tips
- Gear: We provide the necessary gear to keep you safe and comfortable during delivery
- Benefits: 20 paid vacation days + pension contributions from day one
- Flexible schedule: Plan all of your work, yourself through your phone beforehand. We do not set your work schedule

Where will you work?
Join Uber Eats and become part of a global leader in food delivery that offers flexible work opportunities, competitive earnings, and the freedom to choose your own schedule. Whether you're looking for full-time or part-time work, Uber Eats provides a simple way to earn while delivering food and connecting communities. and flexibility. Our shared goal is for all our deliveries to be emission-free by 2040. 

Be part of a movement that’s changing the way the world eats.

What do we ask?
To start as a delivery courier with Uber Eats, you must meet the following conditions:

•            You are at least 16 years old

•            You live in the Netherlands

•            You speak either Dutch or English

•            You have a smartphone with an internet connection

•            You have your own bicycle, e-bike, or scooter

*Please note: delivery using a car, e-step (electric scooter), or any other vehicle is not allowed
